settings.headline: What happens after you eat matters.
settings.intro: INCHY is whole-food nutrition organised around satiety. FORM1 is our unflavoured sacha inchi powder: stir it into food you already eat. Protein and fibre from the same seed, grown in Colombia by farmers we know by name.
settings.note: U.S. launch coming soon. Join the list for launch news and an email when ordering opens.

settings.heading: FORM1 · The pouch
settings.copy: An unflavoured sacha inchi preparation for yoghurt, oats and everyday food. Our proprietary process transforms the seed into a powder while keeping its protein and fibre together.

In Santander, Colombia, we helped growers form ASIN—the Asociación de Sachaincheros del Nororiente Colombiano. We work with its members on quality, prices and purchasing commitments before the seed is planted.

We know who grows our sacha inchi and where it comes from. The product begins in that relationship, long before the seed reaches our process.

settings.association_answer: We helped growers in Santander form ASIN, the Asociación de Sachaincheros del Nororiente Colombiano. Working together on quality, prices and purchasing commitments before planting gives growers a clearer basis for what they produce and gives us a direct relationship with the people behind the seed.
